config.status: Frozen-PINN predictive pointing on the bench as built (photo 2026-10-13). Analytical branch: bench model; empirical branch: measured logs (see docs/empirical_protocol.md).
config.question: With the same PSD information, does disturbance-context prediction beat a tuned PID when the disturbance is the Tx translation the rail can actually produce (HAPS-scaled)?

receiver.principle: A Tx translation D keeps the beam direction; the Rx reducer shifts the beam by D/10 at the FSM and detectors, with no angle. The PSD sees the position; the FSM re-centres it by tilting over the FSM-detector lever: theta_x = D / (2 * 10 * 0.2 m).

rail.axis: x (horizontal, in the FSM plane of incidence: optical gain 2)
rail.note: Travel = PDF FSM limit (1 mrad mechanical) mapped through the lever; beyond it the planned receiver gimbal takes over (not modelled). Speed/acceleration are assumptions until the stage is identified.

pdf_equivalence.derivation: Equal FSM angle: PDF theta = alpha/(2*0.1); bench theta = D/(2*10*0.2 m) -> D = 20 m x alpha. A HAPS lateral displacement X at 20 km gives alpha = X/20 km -> D = X/1000. PDF Table I Tx angle std 5 urad -> 100 um. Detector-plane shift per mechanical FSM angle is 0.4 um/urad in both (lever 0.2 m = PDF lens f).

disturbance.units: Rail position D [m] along x; stored as the equivalent FSM-plane angle D / (reducer x PSD lever).

station.description: HAPS station keeping: slow drift + platform sway + Tx pointing jitter (PDF 5 urad std ~ 100 um)

sweep.description: HAPS lateral motion at 1-5 m/s (rail 1-5 mm/s), reversing within the FSM range, plus the same jitter

fast_jitter.description: Station keeping with faster jitter (2-10 Hz); amplitude limited by the stage acceleration

fast_sweep.description: HAPS lateral motion at 6-14 m/s (rail 6-14 mm/s) within the FSM range, plus jitter

vibration.description: Station keeping plus 6-18 Hz structural vibration injected in software into the FSM command (hidden from all controllers)

acquisition.description: Demo: rail held 2 mm off (beam starts off target) with small jitter

power_metrics.name: pda_bench
power_metrics.note: PDA015C2 (75 um radius) in the unfocused ~0.55 mm beam, as built

power_metrics.name: pdf_focal_equiv
power_metrics.note: Same residual in the PDF receiver: 20 km beam (w 204 mm) clipped by the 100 mm aperture, reduced x0.1, f = 200 mm, 75 um PDA

fsm_jitter_5urad.description: MR-15-30 closed-loop jitter 5 urad instead of 22 urad

psd_capture_15ms_true_10ms_assumed.description: CONEX-PSD capture 15 ms after query while controllers assume 10 ms

psd_capture_5ms_true_10ms_assumed.description: CONEX-PSD capture 5 ms after query (older data) while controllers assume 10 ms

pda_lever_22cm.description: FSM-PDA path 22 cm while FSM-PSD is 20 cm

sweep_rail_accel_1m_s2.description: Sweep set with a 1 m/s^2 stage (faster reversals)

fast_jitter_rail_accel_1m_s2.description: Fast-jitter set with a 1 m/s^2 stage (larger 2-10 Hz jitter)

slow_actuator_20hz.description: Gimbal-class actuator: 20 Hz closed-loop bandwidth on both axes (tests the FSM-dynamics residual)

pid_tuning.note: PID re-tuned on training seeds of each test family (favourable to PID); Frozen-PINN trained once on the mixed training set

comm.detector_note: 75 um: PDA015C2 class (as built); 25 um: high-speed small-area detector (higher bandwidth, more pointing-sensitive)
comm.assumption: IM/DD with signal-independent noise: electrical SNR = aligned SNR x (normalized optical power)^2. Operating point: aligned SNR 3 dB above the 64-QAM HD-FEC threshold.
comm.pilot_note: Pilot block (128 symbols) every 0.5 ms: shorter than the ~1 ms coherence time set by the 300-400 Hz FSM jitter on a 25 um detector (2.6% overhead at 10 Mbaud). Used only by the symbol-level figures; the analytic BER/outage/rate assume known gain.

assumptions: receiver.reducer_magnification = 10: Rx barrel taken as the same 10x expander reversed (wide ends face each other). Check: beam at the FSM ~0.9 mm (reducer) vs ~9 mm (not).
receiver.fsm_to_psd_m = fsm_to_pda_m = 0.20: FSM-cube 10 cm + cube-detector 10 cm, estimated from the photo; measure both paths.
receiver.beam_radius_at_detectors_m = 0.55 mm: F230APC waist 0.435 mm propagated ~0.3 m equivalent; measure with a beam card/profiler.
The CCM1-4ER/M holds the BS021 30:70 cube (split, no focusing). No lens before the PSD/PDA.
FSM folds in the horizontal plane: the horizontal rail motion uses the in-plane axis (optical gain 2).
rail.max_speed_m_s = 20 mm/s and max_accel_m_s2 = 0.2 m/s^2: stage not yet identified. The 1 m/s^2 sensitivity run covers a faster stage.
Rail translation is pure x; stage yaw/pitch runout is not modelled (yaw of 10 urad would add ~20 um at the detectors).
The rail profile is taken as executed exactly; the stage servo error becomes part of the measured disturbance on the bench.
Timing and FSM/PSD models as in pat_bench_v2 (MR-E-3 latency 1 ms, period 2 ms; PSD capture 10 ms after query).
Disturbance families are declared HAPS-scaled test inputs, not measured HAPS data.
config.history: Successor of pat_bench_v3 (legacy/pat_bench_v3_history); earlier studies in legacy/.

information.all_controllers: Delivered PSD frames (x, y) with assumed capture time, own commands, nominal C_F and FSM model, calibrated target
information.predictors_offline: Fitted on open-loop training recordings (FSM held), labels = future PSD frames
information.predictors_online: Additionally refit on the current episode's own past frames
information.pid_tuning: Closed-loop grid search on training episodes (RMS PSD-plane residual)
information.oracle: True disturbance, offset and C_F; bound only
information.hidden: Disturbance, true C_F, FSM offset/jitter, PSD noise
